verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site states it is a "self-hosted Git service under the MIT license." Its source is public on GitHub at go-gitea/gitea, with build-setup and development docs and visible contributor and commit activity. Community users discuss the Go codebase directly, which independently confirms the source is readable. Missing for 10: the repository's LICENSE file is not itself cited, and nothing clarifies whether enterprise-tier features (SAML SSO, audit logs) are also covered by the open license.
